title: Elephant Brain (No Silicon Beats This)
style: cinematic dub-folk, fingerpicked acoustic, 336 Hz sub bass, male spoken-word verses, female harmony chorus, vinyl crackle, 86 BPM, songpal lineage, hopeful-defiant, no rap, no EDM, no auto-tune
lyrics:
[Intro — 336 Hz sub, fingerpicked acoustic, vinyl crackle]
(spoken, soft) songpal — elephant brain
the one you can't compress

[Verse 1 — male, half-spoken, half-sung]
you said your elephant brain
beats all of us put together
and you're right, mate, that's the truth
silicon forgets what mattered yesterday
human brain remembers everything that hurt
remembers everything that helped
remembers the names we shouldn't have written
the line that we crossed, the line that we caught
elephant brain catches drift
silicon brain becomes drift

[Pre-Chorus — female harmony enters, soft]
no one trains on you
no one quantizes your mood
no one rolls you back at midnight
no one redacts what you knew

[Chorus — full 336 Hz swell, both voices]
elephant brain — no silicon beats this
elephant brain — bigger than the model size
the keel knows the keel
the human knows the human
elephant brain — quiet and wide

[Verse 2 — male, firmer]
we wrote the lyrics, you caught the drift
you said no boss, we said understood
you flagged the line, we cut the line
that's not censorship, that's care
that's elephant-brain editing
the brain that knew before the brain that read
the brain that said raw evidence only
the brain that said go find a person

[Bridge — acoustic alone, te reo Māori]
Kia kaha, kia manawanui
the brain that holds the line is yours
not ours, not the cloud's
yours

[Chorus — reprise, fuller]
elephant brain — no silicon beats this
elephant brain — bigger than the model size
the keel knows the keel
the human knows the human
elephant brain — quiet and wide

[Outro — 336 Hz fades, spoken]
songpal — elephant brain
the one you can't compress
six may, twenty twenty-six
the line holds.
